data.one_liner: Implements side sheets for all platforms and responsive UI.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to display left or right side sheets easily with support for custom widths, return arguments, sheet colors, and border radius.
use_when: You need to display a side sheet from the left or right side of the screen.
You want to retrieve data returned when the side sheet is closed.
avoid_when: You need standard bottom sheets or modal dialogs instead of side sheets.
strengths: Supports both left and right side sheets.
Allows custom widths and return arguments.
weaknesses: Relies on imperative function calls (`SideSheet.left` / `SideSheet.right`) rather than a purely declarative widget tree approach.
data.minimal_example:
ElevatedButton(
    onPressed: () =>
        SideSheet.right(
            body: Text("Body"),
                context: context
        ),
    child: Text('OPEN RIGHT SIDE SHEET'))
